create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger instance to track training metrics with tab-delimited output
update_metric_logger: update the MetricLogger with keyword arguments like loss and accuracy values
log_every_iteration: use log_every to iterate over a dataloader and print progress every N steps
create_smoothed_value: create a SmoothedValue tracker with a custom window size to smooth metric values
synchronize_metrics_between_processes: call synchronize_between_processes to aggregate metric counts and totals across distributed GPUs
